items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: we listened to Fletcher Henderson, everybody.

ctx.x: Maybe nine months, maybe a year or something, you know, but it's right along in there, you know, because actually, I could take solos better than I could read then, you know. I could just -- because we would listen to all the records, Coon-Sanders -- that was a good band out of Kansas City, Coon-Sanders Nighthawks -- and we listened to Fletcher Henderson, everybody.
So you had a record player.
